verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents broad programmatic coverage of Outlook mail. It covers drafting, sending, replying, forwarding and deleting messages, attachments, Inbox rules, categories, flags/importance, automatic replies, search, sync, delegation and change notifications. Nothing in the evidence states UI/API parity, and the reference to 'under-exposed Outlook MAPI properties' implies some data is not first-class in the API. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity claim or coverage matrix, evidence for non-mail UI areas (calendar, contacts, settings beyond auto-reply/locale), first-class exposure of all properties without MAPI workarounds, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Draft, read, reply, forward, send, update, or delete messages
